scope: bounded authoring prototype, not scientific/native conformance
red: v6 lacks persistent section editing entry: observed count0, expected1

checks.name: CAD09_SectionEntry_PersistentAndLabelled
checks.proof: An on-canvas section summary exposes Edit section without a menu.

checks.name: Selection_ProfileReaders_NoGeometryMutation
checks.proof: Selecting all authored stations and Source preserves evaluated sections exactly.

checks.name: CAD10_ProfileBank_UndoRedo_Roundtrip
checks.proof: Bank, assignments and source restore together.

checks.name: CAD10_SharedEdit_AllAssignments_NoThicknessRewrite
checks.proof: Shared-profile edits reach root, middle, tip and their blending intervals.

checks.name: CAD10_SourceThickness_ExplicitChannelTransaction
checks.proof: Selected profile and t/c changes accept together and reparse coherently.

checks.name: CAD10_SourceThickness_ConflictingTipLock_Refuses
checks.proof: Shared source-thickness targets cannot silently change a held tip endpoint.

checks.name: ProfileBank_DifferentControlCounts_InspectionAndSelection
checks.proof: Switching between 12- and 6-CV profiles refreshes basis and safely rebinds an out-of-range remembered selection without changing source or geometry.

checks.name: CAD11_InspectOtherStationAndSource_DraftOwnerStable
checks.proof: Read-only inspection preserves draft values and target; Cancel leaves accepted source unchanged.

checks.name: NativeControls_EnterCancelsOrTypes_NeverAppliesUnrelatedDraft
checks.proof: Enter in an alternative-name field or Close button cannot apply the section draft; Enter on Cancel cancels with accepted source unchanged.

checks.name: CAD13_AbsoluteStationBeyondNewTip_Refuses
checks.proof: No clamp, dropped assignment or source mutation.

checks.name: CAD12_AlternativeCompareDiscard_RationaleAndBaselineRetained
checks.proof: Changed shape has no fabricated scientific improvement; Discard restores the complete baseline and retains decision rationale.

checks.name: CAD12_ArchivedAlternativeAndBaseline_ReadOnlyInspection
checks.proof: Retained exact source is reachable; inspection never activates or mutates either branch.

checks.name: CAD12_Keep_PreservesChosenAcceptedGeometry
checks.proof: Keep records rationale without claiming scientific superiority or rolling back the alternative.

checks.name: UntrustedAlternativeName_NoMarkupExecution
checks.proof: Angle brackets and event syntax do not create an image or execute code.

checks.name: UntrustedProfileName_SourceToSection_NoMarkupExecution
checks.proof: A source-authored hostile name remains literal in the station card, section header and accepted source.
